welcome.title: Welcome to myNextDays
welcome.text: First, we set up your business. These company details create your account — you set up your properties afterwards in the Properties area.

company.title: Company details
company.text: These details belong to your account and are used, among other things, for invoices and connecting your booking portals.
company.billingEmailHint: Pre-filled with your login email — editable for invoices/contact.
company.ownerDobCompany: Date of birth of the authorised representative

accommodation.title: Your first property
accommodation.text: These details are required so your property can be fully created on the booking portals.
accommodation.namePlaceholder: e.g. Double room with lake view

done.title: Done — your business is fully set up!
done.text: Your company and first property are set up. Next, set prices and connect your booking channels in the Properties area.

type.title: What do you rent out?
type.text: Choose your business type — it determines terms and modules in your dashboard.

tax.title: Taxes & payments
tax.text: Tax details and the data for payment activation.

exemption.labelGeneric: Exempt from VAT — no VAT ID required
exemption.hintGeneric: Enable this if your business is below the threshold and does not charge VAT.

stopSell.title: Stop-Sell
stopSell.description: Block days from being sold via tour operators (e.g. TUI). Bookings via your platforms are unaffected.
stopSell.calendarHint: Drag across a property's days to select a date range.
stopSell.clearPortalHint: Also removes the portal stops and reopens those days on the booking channels. Use only if the stops were set by mistake.
stopSell.bookedInRange: {n} booked day(s) in the range — no stop-sell is set there (overlaps a booking).
stopSell.resetAllWarn: Removes ALL stop-sells (including portal stops) for every property and reopens those days on the booking channels. This cannot be undone.
stopSell.resetPropertyWarn: Removes ALL stop-sells (including portal stops) for “{title}” and reopens those days on the booking channels. This cannot be undone.
stopSell.resetConfirmAgain: Please confirm once more to be safe.

inbox.empty: No messages yet. OTA bookings will appear here once they arrive.

inbox.manageAiDesc: Ton, Sprache und Verhalten der KI-Antworten festlegen.
inbox.manageAutoDesc: Automatische Nachrichten zu Buchung, Anreise und Abreise.
inbox.notePrompt: Interne Notiz (nur für das Team sichtbar):
